description: Public-domain face photos (US federal government works on Wikimedia Commons) for the vision real-model tests and the synthetic ID and fake-camera generators. Fetch with python3 scripts/fetch_fixtures.py into fixtures/faces/; generated assets go to fixtures/generated/. Both directories are gitignored: never commit the images. Each license template was confirmed by reading the file page wikitext; sha1 is Commons' SHA-1, which finds an archived revision when a re-upload changes the bytes behind the URL; face_box is the YuNet box in source pixels (measured once at a 640-pixel long side) that the generators use to frame crops. The forms list (Phase 5, C60.7, decision 18) pins the blank US federal forms of the held-out document set: works of the US federal government, public domain under 17 U.S.C. 105, fetched by the same script from prior-year irs.gov URLs (superseded revisions, whose bytes no longer change) into fixtures/generated/federal-forms/ (gitignored); pages are the 1-based pages the generator fills with synthetic values and keeps. Never commit them.
